name: specforge-ai-coding-bootcamp
description: Spec-driven Markdown course material pipeline for an enterprise AI-assisted coding bootcamp.

scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:slidev && npm run generate:llm && npm run generate:ppt-ai
scripts.build: npm run generate && rm -rf dist/slides && slidev build build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp-7h.slidev.md --out $PWD/dist/slides --router-mode hash
scripts.export:pptx: npm run generate && node scripts/ensure-export-deps.mjs && slidev export build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp-7h.slidev.md --format pptx --output $PWD/dist/ai-coding-bootcamp-7h.pptx --timeout 120000
scripts.export:pdf: npm run generate && node scripts/ensure-export-deps.mjs && slidev export build/slides/ai-coding-bootcamp-7h.slidev.md --format pdf --output $PWD/dist/ai-coding-bootcamp-7h.pdf --timeout 120000
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run generate && npm run build
